name: Methow River (Carlton – Pateros)
blurb: Dry-side canyon float down to the Columbia — mellow above Averill, splashy Black Canyon below.

sections.notes: Unimproved river access at both ends; toilets. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass required at both WDFW sites.

Black Canyon: Class III rapids with Black Canyon rapid (III+) at AW mile ~9.8. Bridge 1 Access (mile ~13) is an intermediate exit. Zahn's access is private. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass at Averill (WDFW); Pateros take-out is Douglas PUD.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
